return <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: label }} />;
cannotTest: Whether code is efficient for lowest-spec environments, free of duplication or technical debt, and free of memory leaks (for example timers, listeners or subscriptions that are never cleaned up, unnecessary re-renders, missing memoization) needs human judgement. The checks above only catch common security and hygiene shortcuts; a reviewer must judge the rest.
